verses.arabic: كٓهيعٓصٓ
verses.english: Kaf, Ha, Ya, ‘Ayn, Suad.
verses.transliteration_html: K<u>a</u>fh<u>a</u>y<u>a</u>AAayn<u>sa</u>d
verses.transliteration_text: KafhayaAAaynsad

verses.arabic: ذِكْرُ رَحْمَتِ رَبِّكَ عَبْدَهُۥ زَكَرِيَّآ
verses.english: [This is] an account of your Lord’s mercy on His servant, Zechariah,
verses.transliteration_html: <u>Th</u>ikru ra<u>h</u>mati rabbika AAabdahu zakariyy<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Thikru rahmati rabbika AAabdahu zakariyya

verses.arabic: إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥ نِدَآءً خَفِيًّۭا
verses.english: when he called out to his Lord with a secret cry.
verses.transliteration_html: Ith nada rabbahu nidaan khafiyyan
verses.transliteration_text: Ith nada rabbahu nidaan khafiyyan

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى وَهَنَ ٱلْعَظْمُ مِنِّى وَٱشْتَعَلَ ٱلرَّأْسُ شَيْبًۭا وَلَمْ أَكُنۢ بِدُعَآئِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيًّۭا
verses.english: He said, ‘My Lord! Indeed my bones have become feeble, and my head has turned white with age, yet never have I, my Lord, been disappointed in supplicating You!
verses.transliteration_html: Qala rabbi innee wahana alAAathmu minnee waishtaAAala alrrasu shayban walam akun biduAAaika rabbi shaqiyyan
verses.transliteration_text: Qala rabbi innee wahana alAAathmu minnee waishtaAAala alrrasu shayban walam akun biduAAaika rabbi shaqiyyan

verses.arabic: وَإِنِّى خِفْتُ ٱلْمَوَٰلِىَ مِن وَرَآءِى وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًۭا فَهَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّۭا
verses.english: Indeed I fear my kinsmen, after me, and my wife is barren. So grant me from Yourself an heir
verses.transliteration_html: Wainnee khiftu almawaliya min waraee wakanati imraatee AAaqiran fahab lee min ladunka waliyyan
verses.transliteration_text: Wainnee khiftu almawaliya min waraee wakanati imraatee AAaqiran fahab lee min ladunka waliyyan

verses.arabic: يَرِثُنِى وَيَرِثُ مِنْ ءَالِ يَعْقُوبَ ۖ وَٱجْعَلْهُ رَبِّ رَضِيًّۭا
verses.english: who may inherit from me and inherit from the House of Jacob, and make him, my Lord, pleasing [to You]!’
verses.transliteration_html: Yarithunee wayarithu min ali yaAAqooba waijAAalhu rabbi radiyyan
verses.transliteration_text: Yarithunee wayarithu min ali yaAAqooba waijAAalhu rabbi radiyyan

verses.arabic: يَـٰزَكَرِيَّآ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَـٰمٍ ٱسْمُهُۥ يَحْيَىٰ لَمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُۥ مِن قَبْلُ سَمِيًّۭا
verses.english: ‘O Zechariah! Indeed We give you the good news of a son, whose name is ‘‘John.’’ Never before have We made anyone his namesake.’
verses.transliteration_html: Ya zakariyya inna nubashshiruka bighulamin ismuhu yahya lam najAAal lahu min qablu samiyyan
verses.transliteration_text: Ya zakariyya inna nubashshiruka bighulamin ismuhu yahya lam najAAal lahu min qablu samiyyan

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَـٰمٌۭ وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًۭا وَقَدْ بَلَغْتُ مِنَ ٱلْكِبَرِ عِتِيًّۭا
verses.english: He said, ‘My Lord! How shall I have a son, when my wife is barren, and I am already advanced in age?’
verses.transliteration_html: Qala rabbi anna yakoonu lee ghulamun wakanati imraatee AAaqiran waqad balaghtu mina alkibari AAitiyyan
verses.transliteration_text: Qala rabbi anna yakoonu lee ghulamun wakanati imraatee AAaqiran waqad balaghtu mina alkibari AAitiyyan

verses.arabic: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ قَالَ رَبُّكَ هُوَ عَلَىَّ هَيِّنٌۭ وَقَدْ خَلَقْتُكَ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَمْ تَكُ شَيْـًۭٔا
verses.english: He said, ‘So shall it be. Your Lord has said, ‘‘It is simple for Me.’’ Certainly I created you before when you were nothing.’
verses.transliteration_html: Qala kathalika qala rabbuka huwa AAalayya hayyinun waqad khalaqtuka min qablu walam taku shayan
verses.transliteration_text: Qala kathalika qala rabbuka huwa AAalayya hayyinun waqad khalaqtuka min qablu walam taku shayan

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱجْعَل لِّىٓ ءَايَةًۭ ۚ قَالَ ءَايَتُكَ أَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ ٱلنَّاسَ ثَلَـٰثَ لَيَالٍۢ سَوِيًّۭا
verses.english: He said, ‘My Lord! Appoint a sign for me.’ He said, ‘Your sign is that you will not speak to the people for three complete nights.’
verses.transliteration_html: Qala rabbi ijAAal lee ayatan qala ayatuka alla tukallima alnnasa thalatha layalin sawiyyan
verses.transliteration_text: Qala rabbi ijAAal lee ayatan qala ayatuka alla tukallima alnnasa thalatha layalin sawiyyan

verses.arabic: فَخَرَجَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلْمِحْرَابِ فَأَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِمْ أَن سَبِّحُوا۟ بُكْرَةًۭ وَعَشِيًّۭا
verses.english: So he emerged before his people from the Temple, and signalled to them that they should glorify [Allah] morning and evening.
verses.transliteration_html: Fakharaja AAala qawmihi mina almihrabi faawha ilayhim an sabbihoo bukratan waAAashiyyan
verses.transliteration_text: Fakharaja AAala qawmihi mina almihrabi faawha ilayhim an sabbihoo bukratan waAAashiyyan

verses.arabic: يَـٰيَحْيَىٰ خُذِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ بِقُوَّةٍۢ ۖ وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ ٱلْحُكْمَ صَبِيًّۭا
verses.english: ‘O John!’ [We said,] ‘Hold on with power to the Book!’ And We gave him judgement while still a child,
verses.transliteration_html: Ya yahya khuthi alkitaba biquwwatin waataynahu alhukma sabiyyan
verses.transliteration_text: Ya yahya khuthi alkitaba biquwwatin waataynahu alhukma sabiyyan

verses.arabic: وَحَنَانًۭا مِّن لَّدُنَّا وَزَكَوٰةًۭ ۖ وَكَانَ تَقِيًّۭا
verses.english: and a compassion and purity from Us. He was Godwary
verses.transliteration_html: Wahananan min ladunna wazakatan wakana taqiyyan
verses.transliteration_text: Wahananan min ladunna wazakatan wakana taqiyyan

verses.arabic: وَبَرًّۢا بِوَٰلِدَيْهِ وَلَمْ يَكُن جَبَّارًا عَصِيًّۭا
verses.english: and good to his parents, and was not self-willed or disobedient.
verses.transliteration_html: Wabarran biwalidayhi walam yakun jabbaran AAasiyyan
verses.transliteration_text: Wabarran biwalidayhi walam yakun jabbaran AAasiyyan

verses.arabic: وَسَلَـٰمٌ عَلَيْهِ يَوْمَ وُلِدَ وَيَوْمَ يَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ يُبْعَثُ حَيًّۭا
verses.english: Peace be to him, the day he was born, and the day he dies, and the day he is raised alive!
verses.transliteration_html: Wasalamun AAalayhi yawma wulida wayawma yamootu wayawma yubAAathu hayyan
verses.transliteration_text: Wasalamun AAalayhi yawma wulida wayawma yamootu wayawma yubAAathu hayyan

verses.arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مَرْيَمَ إِذِ ٱنتَبَذَتْ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا مَكَانًۭا شَرْقِيًّۭا
verses.english: And mention in the Book Mary, when she withdrew from her family to an easterly place.
verses.transliteration_html: Waothkur fee alkitabi maryama ithi intabathat min ahliha makanan sharqiyyan
verses.transliteration_text: Waothkur fee alkitabi maryama ithi intabathat min ahliha makanan sharqiyyan

verses.arabic: فَٱتَّخَذَتْ مِن دُونِهِمْ حِجَابًۭا فَأَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهَا رُوحَنَا فَتَمَثَّلَ لَهَا بَشَرًۭا سَوِيًّۭا
verses.english: Thus did she seclude herself from them, whereupon We sent to her Our Spirit and he became incarnate for her as a well-proportioned human.
verses.transliteration_html: Faittakhathat min doonihim hijaban faarsalna ilayha roohana fatamaththala laha basharan sawiyyan
verses.transliteration_text: Faittakhathat min doonihim hijaban faarsalna ilayha roohana fatamaththala laha basharan sawiyyan

verses.arabic: قَالَتْ إِنِّىٓ أَعُوذُ بِٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ مِنكَ إِن كُنتَ تَقِيًّۭا
verses.english: She said, ‘I seek the protection of the All-beneficent from you, should you be Godwary!’
verses.transliteration_html: Qalat innee aAAoothu bialrrahmani minka in kunta taqiyyan
verses.transliteration_text: Qalat innee aAAoothu bialrrahmani minka in kunta taqiyyan

verses.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ رَسُولُ رَبِّكِ لِأَهَبَ لَكِ غُلَـٰمًۭا زَكِيًّۭا
verses.english: He said, ‘I am only a messenger of your Lord that I may give you a pure son.’
verses.transliteration_html: Qala innama ana rasoolu rabbiki liahaba laki ghulaman zakiyyan
verses.transliteration_text: Qala innama ana rasoolu rabbiki liahaba laki ghulaman zakiyyan

verses.arabic: قَالَتْ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَـٰمٌۭ وَلَمْ يَمْسَسْنِى بَشَرٌۭ وَلَمْ أَكُ بَغِيًّۭا
verses.english: She said, ‘How shall I have a child seeing that no human being has ever touched me, nor have I been unchaste?’
verses.transliteration_html: Qalat anna yakoonu lee ghulamun walam yamsasnee basharun walam aku baghiyyan
verses.transliteration_text: Qalat anna yakoonu lee ghulamun walam yamsasnee basharun walam aku baghiyyan

verses.arabic: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ هُوَ عَلَىَّ هَيِّنٌۭ ۖ وَلِنَجْعَلَهُۥٓ ءَايَةًۭ لِّلنَّاسِ وَرَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرًۭا مَّقْضِيًّۭا
verses.english: He said, ‘So shall it be. Your Lord says, ‘‘It is simple for Me.’’ And so that We may make him a sign for mankind and a mercy from Us, and it is a matter [already] decided.’
verses.transliteration_html: Qala kathaliki qala rabbuki huwa AAalayya hayyinun walinajAAalahu ayatan lilnnasi warahmatan minna wakana amran maqdiyyan
verses.transliteration_text: Qala kathaliki qala rabbuki huwa AAalayya hayyinun walinajAAalahu ayatan lilnnasi warahmatan minna wakana amran maqdiyyan

verses.arabic: ۞ فَحَمَلَتْهُ فَٱنتَبَذَتْ بِهِۦ مَكَانًۭا قَصِيًّۭا
verses.english: Thus she conceived him, then withdrew with him to a distant place.
verses.transliteration_html: Fahamalathu faintabathat bihi makanan qasiyyan
verses.transliteration_text: Fahamalathu faintabathat bihi makanan qasiyyan

verses.arabic: فَأَجَآءَهَا ٱلْمَخَاضُ إِلَىٰ جِذْعِ ٱلنَّخْلَةِ قَالَتْ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى مِتُّ قَبْلَ هَـٰذَا وَكُنتُ نَسْيًۭا مَّنسِيًّۭا
verses.english: The birth pangs brought her to the trunk of a date palm. She said, ‘I wish I had died before this and become a forgotten thing, beyond recall.’
verses.transliteration_html: Faajaaha almakhadu ila jithAAi alnnakhlati qalat ya laytanee mittu qabla hatha wakuntu nasyan mansiyyan
verses.transliteration_text: Faajaaha almakhadu ila jithAAi alnnakhlati qalat ya laytanee mittu qabla hatha wakuntu nasyan mansiyyan

verses.arabic: فَنَادَىٰهَا مِن تَحْتِهَآ أَلَّا تَحْزَنِى قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّۭا
verses.english: Thereupon he called her from below her [saying,] ‘Do not grieve! Your Lord has made a spring to flow at your feet.
verses.transliteration_html: Fanadaha min tahtiha alla tahzanee qad jaAAala rabbuki tahtaki sariyyan
verses.transliteration_text: Fanadaha min tahtiha alla tahzanee qad jaAAala rabbuki tahtaki sariyyan

verses.arabic: وَهُزِّىٓ إِلَيْكِ بِجِذْعِ ٱلنَّخْلَةِ تُسَـٰقِطْ عَلَيْكِ رُطَبًۭا جَنِيًّۭا
verses.english: Shake the trunk of the palm tree, freshly picked dates will drop upon you.
verses.transliteration_html: Wahuzzee ilayki bijithAAi alnnakhlati tusaqit AAalayki rutaban janiyyan
verses.transliteration_text: Wahuzzee ilayki bijithAAi alnnakhlati tusaqit AAalayki rutaban janiyyan

verses.arabic: فَكُلِى وَٱشْرَبِى وَقَرِّى عَيْنًۭا ۖ فَإِمَّا تَرَيِنَّ مِنَ ٱلْبَشَرِ أَحَدًۭا فَقُولِىٓ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ صَوْمًۭا فَلَنْ أُكَلِّمَ ٱلْيَوْمَ إِنسِيًّۭا
verses.english: Eat, drink, and be comforted. Then if you see any human, say, ‘‘Indeed I have vowed a fast to the All-beneficent, so I will not speak to any human today.’’ ’
verses.transliteration_html: Fakulee waishrabee waqarree AAaynan faimma tarayinna mina albashari ahadan faqoolee innee nathartu lilrrahmani sawman falan okallima alyawma insiyyan
verses.transliteration_text: Fakulee waishrabee waqarree AAaynan faimma tarayinna mina albashari ahadan faqoolee innee nathartu lilrrahmani sawman falan okallima alyawma insiyyan

verses.arabic: فَأَتَتْ بِهِۦ قَوْمَهَا تَحْمِلُهُۥ ۖ قَالُوا۟ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ لَقَدْ جِئْتِ شَيْـًۭٔا فَرِيًّۭا
verses.english: Then carrying him she brought him to her people. They said, ‘O Mary, you have certainly come up with an odd thing!
verses.transliteration_html: Faatat bihi qawmaha tahmiluhu qaloo ya maryamu laqad jiti shayan fariyyan
verses.transliteration_text: Faatat bihi qawmaha tahmiluhu qaloo ya maryamu laqad jiti shayan fariyyan

verses.arabic: يَـٰٓأُخْتَ هَـٰرُونَ مَا كَانَ أَبُوكِ ٱمْرَأَ سَوْءٍۢ وَمَا كَانَتْ أُمُّكِ بَغِيًّۭا
verses.english: O sister of Aaron[’s lineage]! Your father was not an evil man, nor was your mother unchaste.’
verses.transliteration_html: Ya okhta haroona ma kana abooki imraa sawin wama kanat ommuki baghiyyan
verses.transliteration_text: Ya okhta haroona ma kana abooki imraa sawin wama kanat ommuki baghiyyan

verses.arabic: فَأَشَارَتْ إِلَيْهِ ۖ قَالُوا۟ كَيْفَ نُكَلِّمُ مَن كَانَ فِى ٱلْمَهْدِ صَبِيًّۭا
verses.english: Thereat she pointed to him. They said, ‘How can we speak to one who is yet a baby in the cradle?’
verses.transliteration_html: Faasharat ilayhi qaloo kayfa nukallimu man kana fee almahdi sabiyyan
verses.transliteration_text: Faasharat ilayhi qaloo kayfa nukallimu man kana fee almahdi sabiyyan

verses.arabic: قَالَ إِنِّى عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ ءَاتَىٰنِىَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَجَعَلَنِى نَبِيًّۭا
verses.english: He said, ‘Indeed I am a servant of Allah! He has given me the Book and made me a prophet.
verses.transliteration_html: Qala innee AAabdu Allahi ataniya alkitaba wajaAAalanee nabiyyan
verses.transliteration_text: Qala innee AAabdu Allahi ataniya alkitaba wajaAAalanee nabiyyan

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلَنِى مُبَارَكًا أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُ وَأَوْصَـٰنِى بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ مَا دُمْتُ حَيًّۭا
verses.english: He has made me blessed, wherever I may be, and He has enjoined me to [maintain] the prayer and to [pay] the zakat as long as I live,
verses.transliteration_html: WajaAAalanee mubarakan ayna ma kuntu waawsanee bialssalati waalzzakati ma dumtu hayyan
verses.transliteration_text: WajaAAalanee mubarakan ayna ma kuntu waawsanee bialssalati waalzzakati ma dumtu hayyan

verses.arabic: وَبَرًّۢا بِوَٰلِدَتِى وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْنِى جَبَّارًۭا شَقِيًّۭا
verses.english: and to be good to my mother, and He has not made me self-willed and wretched.
verses.transliteration_html: Wabarran biwalidatee walam yajAAalnee jabbaran shaqiyyan
verses.transliteration_text: Wabarran biwalidatee walam yajAAalnee jabbaran shaqiyyan

verses.arabic: وَٱلسَّلَـٰمُ عَلَىَّ يَوْمَ وُلِدتُّ وَيَوْمَ أَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ أُبْعَثُ حَيًّۭا
verses.english: Peace to me the day I was born, and the day I die, and the day I am raised alive.’
verses.transliteration_html: Waalssalamu AAalayya yawma wulidtu wayawma amootu wayawma obAAathu hayyan
verses.transliteration_text: Waalssalamu AAalayya yawma wulidtu wayawma amootu wayawma obAAathu hayyan

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ ۚ قَوْلَ ٱلْحَقِّ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ
verses.english: That is Jesus, son of Mary, a Word of the Real concerning whom they are in doubt.
verses.transliteration_html: Thalika AAeesa ibnu maryama qawla alhaqqi allathee feehi yamtaroona
verses.transliteration_text: Thalika AAeesa ibnu maryama qawla alhaqqi allathee feehi yamtaroona

verses.arabic: مَا كَانَ لِلَّهِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ مِن وَلَدٍۢ ۖ سُبْحَـٰنَهُۥٓ ۚ إِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمْرًۭا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
verses.english: It is not for Allah to take a son. Immaculate is He! When He decides on a matter, He just says to it, ‘Be!’ and it is.
verses.transliteration_html: Ma kana lillahi an yattakhitha min waladin subhanahu itha qada amran fainnama yaqoolu lahu kun fayakoonu
verses.transliteration_text: Ma kana lillahi an yattakhitha min waladin subhanahu itha qada amran fainnama yaqoolu lahu kun fayakoonu

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّى وَرَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌۭ مُّسْتَقِيمٌۭ
verses.english: [And Jesus said,] ‘Indeed Allah is my Lord and your Lord. So worship Him. This is a straight path.’
verses.transliteration_html: Wainna Allaha rabbee warabbukum faoAAbudoohu hatha siratun mustaqeemun
verses.transliteration_text: Wainna Allaha rabbee warabbukum faoAAbudoohu hatha siratun mustaqeemun

verses.arabic: فَٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَيْنِهِمْ ۖ فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن مَّشْهَدِ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
verses.english: But the factions differed among themselves. So woe to the faithless at the scene of a tremendous day.
verses.transliteration_html: Faikhtalafa alahzabu min baynihim fawaylun lillatheena kafaroo min mashhadi yawmin AAatheemin
verses.transliteration_text: Faikhtalafa alahzabu min baynihim fawaylun lillatheena kafaroo min mashhadi yawmin AAatheemin

verses.arabic: أَسْمِعْ بِهِمْ وَأَبْصِرْ يَوْمَ يَأْتُونَنَا ۖ لَـٰكِنِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
verses.english: How well they will hear and how well they will see on the day when they come to Us! But today the wrongdoers are in manifest error.
verses.transliteration_html: AsmiAA bihim waabsir yawma yatoonana lakini alththalimoona alyawma fee dalalin mubeenin
verses.transliteration_text: AsmiAA bihim waabsir yawma yatoonana lakini alththalimoona alyawma fee dalalin mubeenin

verses.arabic: وَأَنذِرْهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْحَسْرَةِ إِذْ قُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ وَهُمْ فِى غَفْلَةٍۢ وَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.english: Warn them of the Day of Regret, when the matter will be decided, while they are [yet] heedless and do not have faith.
verses.transliteration_html: Waanthirhum yawma alhasrati ith qudiya alamru wahum fee ghaflatin wahum la yuminoona
verses.transliteration_text: Waanthirhum yawma alhasrati ith qudiya alamru wahum fee ghaflatin wahum la yuminoona

verses.arabic: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَرِثُ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَنْ عَلَيْهَا وَإِلَيْنَا يُرْجَعُونَ
verses.english: Indeed We shall inherit the earth and whoever there is on it, and to Us they shall be brought back.
verses.transliteration_html: Inna nahnu narithu alarda waman AAalayha wailayna yurjaAAoona
verses.transliteration_text: Inna nahnu narithu alarda waman AAalayha wailayna yurjaAAoona

verses.arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقًۭا نَّبِيًّا
verses.english: And mention in the Book Abraham. Indeed, he was a truthful man and a prophet.
verses.transliteration_html: Waothkur fee alkitabi ibraheema innahu kana siddeeqan nabiyyan
verses.transliteration_text: Waothkur fee alkitabi ibraheema innahu kana siddeeqan nabiyyan

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ لِمَ تَعْبُدُ مَا لَا يَسْمَعُ وَلَا يُبْصِرُ وَلَا يُغْنِى عَنكَ شَيْـًۭٔا
verses.english: When he said to his father, ‘Father! Why do you worship that which neither hears nor sees, and is of no avail to you in any way?
verses.transliteration_html: Ith qala liabeehi ya abati lima taAAbudu ma la yasmaAAu wala yubsiru wala yughnee AAanka shayan
verses.transliteration_text: Ith qala liabeehi ya abati lima taAAbudu ma la yasmaAAu wala yubsiru wala yughnee AAanka shayan

verses.arabic: يَـٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّى قَدْ جَآءَنِى مِنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ مَا لَمْ يَأْتِكَ فَٱتَّبِعْنِىٓ أَهْدِكَ صِرَٰطًۭا سَوِيًّۭا
verses.english: Father! Indeed a knowledge has already come to me, which has not come to you. So follow me that I may guide you to a right path.
verses.transliteration_html: Ya abati innee qad jaanee mina alAAilmi ma lam yatika faittabiAAnee ahdika siratan sawiyyan
verses.transliteration_text: Ya abati innee qad jaanee mina alAAilmi ma lam yatika faittabiAAnee ahdika siratan sawiyyan

verses.arabic: يَـٰٓأَبَتِ لَا تَعْبُدِ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنَ كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ عَصِيًّۭا
verses.english: Father! Do not worship Satan. Indeed Satan is disobedient to the All-beneficent.
verses.transliteration_html: Ya abati la taAAbudi alshshaytana inna alshshaytana kana lilrrahmani AAasiyyan
verses.transliteration_text: Ya abati la taAAbudi alshshaytana inna alshshaytana kana lilrrahmani AAasiyyan

verses.arabic: يَـٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يَمَسَّكَ عَذَابٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ فَتَكُونَ لِلشَّيْطَـٰنِ وَلِيًّۭا
verses.english: Father! I am indeed afraid that a punishment from the All-beneficent will befall you, and you will become Satan’s accomplice.’
verses.transliteration_html: Ya abati innee akhafu an yamassaka AAathabun mina alrrahmani fatakoona lilshshyatani waliyyan
verses.transliteration_text: Ya abati innee akhafu an yamassaka AAathabun mina alrrahmani fatakoona lilshshyatani waliyyan

verses.arabic: قَالَ أَرَاغِبٌ أَنتَ عَنْ ءَالِهَتِى يَـٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ ۖ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ لَأَرْجُمَنَّكَ ۖ وَٱهْجُرْنِى مَلِيًّۭا
verses.english: He said, ‘Abraham! Are you renouncing my gods? If you do not desist, I will stone you. Get away from me for a long while.’
verses.transliteration_html: Qala araghibun anta AAan alihatee ya ibraheemu lain lam tantahi laarjumannaka waohjurnee maliyyan
verses.transliteration_text: Qala araghibun anta AAan alihatee ya ibraheemu lain lam tantahi laarjumannaka waohjurnee maliyyan

verses.arabic: قَالَ سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَيْكَ ۖ سَأَسْتَغْفِرُ لَكَ رَبِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِى حَفِيًّۭا
verses.english: He said, ‘Peace be to you! I shall plead with my Lord to forgive you. Indeed, He is gracious to me.
verses.transliteration_html: Qala salamun AAalayka saastaghfiru laka rabbee innahu kana bee hafiyyan
verses.transliteration_text: Qala salamun AAalayka saastaghfiru laka rabbee innahu kana bee hafiyyan

verses.arabic: وَأَعْتَزِلُكُمْ وَمَا تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَدْعُوا۟ رَبِّى عَسَىٰٓ أَلَّآ أَكُونَ بِدُعَآءِ رَبِّى شَقِيًّۭا
verses.english: I dissociate myself from you and whatever you invoke besides Allah. I will supplicate my Lord. Hopefully, I will not be disappointed in supplicating my Lord.’
verses.transliteration_html: WaaAAtazilukum wama tadAAoona min dooni Allahi waadAAoo rabbee AAasa alla akoona biduAAai rabbee shaqiyyan
verses.transliteration_text: WaaAAtazilukum wama tadAAoona min dooni Allahi waadAAoo rabbee AAasa alla akoona biduAAai rabbee shaqiyyan

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا ٱعْتَزَلَهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسْحَـٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ ۖ وَكُلًّۭا جَعَلْنَا نَبِيًّۭا
verses.english: So when he had left them and what they worshipped besides Allah, We gave him Isaac and Jacob, and each We made a prophet.
verses.transliteration_html: Falamma iAAtazalahum wama yaAAbudoona min dooni Allahi wahabna lahu ishaqa wayaAAqooba wakullan jaAAalna nabiyyan
verses.transliteration_text: Falamma iAAtazalahum wama yaAAbudoona min dooni Allahi wahabna lahu ishaqa wayaAAqooba wakullan jaAAalna nabiyyan

verses.arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُم مِّن رَّحْمَتِنَا وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ عَلِيًّۭا
verses.english: And We gave them out of Our mercy, and conferred on them a worthy and lofty repute.
verses.transliteration_html: Wawahabna lahum min rahmatina wajaAAalna lahum lisana sidqin AAaliyyan
verses.transliteration_text: Wawahabna lahum min rahmatina wajaAAalna lahum lisana sidqin AAaliyyan

verses.arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مُوسَىٰٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مُخْلَصًۭا وَكَانَ رَسُولًۭا نَّبِيًّۭا
verses.english: And mention in the Book Moses. Indeed he was exclusively dedicated [to Allah], and an apostle and prophet.
verses.transliteration_html: Waothkur fee alkitabi moosa innahu kana mukhlasan wakana rasoolan nabiyyan
verses.transliteration_text: Waothkur fee alkitabi moosa innahu kana mukhlasan wakana rasoolan nabiyyan

verses.arabic: وَنَـٰدَيْنَـٰهُ مِن جَانِبِ ٱلطُّورِ ٱلْأَيْمَنِ وَقَرَّبْنَـٰهُ نَجِيًّۭا
verses.english: We called him from the right side of the Mount and We drew him near [to Ourselves] for confidential discourse.
verses.transliteration_html: Wanadaynahu min janibi alttoori alaymani waqarrabnahu najiyyan
verses.transliteration_text: Wanadaynahu min janibi alttoori alaymani waqarrabnahu najiyyan

verses.arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥ مِن رَّحْمَتِنَآ أَخَاهُ هَـٰرُونَ نَبِيًّۭا
verses.english: And We gave him out of Our mercy his brother Aaron, a prophet.
verses.transliteration_html: Wawahabna lahu min rahmatina akhahu haroona nabiyyan
verses.transliteration_text: Wawahabna lahu min rahmatina akhahu haroona nabiyyan

verses.arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ إِسْمَـٰعِيلَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صَادِقَ ٱلْوَعْدِ وَكَانَ رَسُولًۭا نَّبِيًّۭا
verses.english: And mention in the Book Ishmael. Indeed, he was true to his promise, and an apostle and prophet.
verses.transliteration_html: Waothkur fee alkitabi ismaAAeela innahu kana sadiqa alwaAAdi wakana rasoolan nabiyyan
verses.transliteration_text: Waothkur fee alkitabi ismaAAeela innahu kana sadiqa alwaAAdi wakana rasoolan nabiyyan

verses.arabic: وَكَانَ يَأْمُرُ أَهْلَهُۥ بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ وَكَانَ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦ مَرْضِيًّۭا
verses.english: He used to bid his family to [maintain] the prayer and to [pay] the zakat, and was pleasing to his Lord.
verses.transliteration_html: Wakana yamuru ahlahu bialssalati waalzzakati wakana AAinda rabbihi mardiyyan
verses.transliteration_text: Wakana yamuru ahlahu bialssalati waalzzakati wakana AAinda rabbihi mardiyyan

verses.arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ إِدْرِيسَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقًۭا نَّبِيًّۭا
verses.english: And mention in the Book Idrees. Indeed, he was a truthful one and a prophet,
verses.transliteration_html: Waothkur fee alkitabi idreesa innahu kana siddeeqan nabiyyan
verses.transliteration_text: Waothkur fee alkitabi idreesa innahu kana siddeeqan nabiyyan

verses.arabic: وَرَفَعْنَـٰهُ مَكَانًا عَلِيًّا
verses.english: and We raised him to an exalted station.
verses.transliteration_html: WarafaAAnahu makanan AAaliyyan
verses.transliteration_text: WarafaAAnahu makanan AAaliyyan

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ مِن ذُرِّيَّةِ ءَادَمَ وَمِمَّنْ حَمَلْنَا مَعَ نُوحٍۢ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّةِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَمِمَّنْ هَدَيْنَا وَٱجْتَبَيْنَآ ۚ إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَـٰتُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ خَرُّوا۟ سُجَّدًۭا وَبُكِيًّۭا ۩
verses.english: They are the ones whom Allah has blessed from among the prophets of Adam’s progeny, and from [the progeny of] those We carried with Noah, and from among the progeny of Abraham and Israel, and from among those that We guided and chose. When the signs of the All-beneficent were recited to them, they would fall down weeping in prostration.
verses.transliteration_html: Olaika allatheena anAAama Allahu AAalayhim mina alnnabiyyeena min thurriyyati adama wamimman hamalna maAAa noohin wamin thurriyyati ibraheema waisraeela wamimman hadayna waijtabayna itha tutla AAalayhim ayatu alrrahmani kharroo sujjadan wabukiyyan
verses.transliteration_text: Olaika allatheena anAAama Allahu AAalayhim mina alnnabiyyeena min thurriyyati adama wamimman hamalna maAAa noohin wamin thurriyyati ibraheema waisraeela wamimman hadayna waijtabayna itha tutla AAalayhim ayatu alrrahmani kharroo sujjadan wabukiyyan

verses.arabic: ۞ فَخَلَفَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ أَضَاعُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ ٱلشَّهَوَٰتِ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَلْقَوْنَ غَيًّا
verses.english: But they were succeeded by an evil posterity who neglected the prayer, and followed [their base] appetites. So they will soon encounter [the reward of] perversity,
verses.transliteration_html: Fakhalafa min baAAdihim khalfun adaAAoo alssalata waittabaAAoo alshshahawati fasawfa yalqawna ghayyan
verses.transliteration_text: Fakhalafa min baAAdihim khalfun adaAAoo alssalata waittabaAAoo alshshahawati fasawfa yalqawna ghayyan

verses.arabic: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًۭا فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يَدْخُلُونَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ وَلَا يُظْلَمُونَ شَيْـًۭٔا
verses.english: barring those who repent, believe, and act righteously. Such will enter paradise, and they will not be wronged in the least.
verses.transliteration_html: Illa man taba waamana waAAamila salihan faolaika yadkhuloona aljannata wala yuthlamoona shayan
verses.transliteration_text: Illa man taba waamana waAAamila salihan faolaika yadkhuloona aljannata wala yuthlamoona shayan

verses.arabic: جَنَّـٰتِ عَدْنٍ ٱلَّتِى وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ عِبَادَهُۥ بِٱلْغَيْبِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَأْتِيًّۭا
verses.english: Gardens of Eden promised by the All-beneficent to His servants, [while they were still] unseen. Indeed His promise is bound to come to pass.
verses.transliteration_html: Jannati AAadnin allatee waAAada alrrahmanu AAibadahu bialghaybi innahu kana waAAduhu matiyyan
verses.transliteration_text: Jannati AAadnin allatee waAAada alrrahmanu AAibadahu bialghaybi innahu kana waAAduhu matiyyan

verses.arabic: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا إِلَّا سَلَـٰمًۭا ۖ وَلَهُمْ رِزْقُهُمْ فِيهَا بُكْرَةًۭ وَعَشِيًّۭا
verses.english: Therein they will not hear vain talk, but only ‘Peace!’ Therein they will have their provision morning and evening.
verses.transliteration_html: La yasmaAAoona feeha laghwan illa salaman walahum rizquhum feeha bukratan waAAashiyyan
verses.transliteration_text: La yasmaAAoona feeha laghwan illa salaman walahum rizquhum feeha bukratan waAAashiyyan

verses.arabic: تِلْكَ ٱلْجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِى نُورِثُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا مَن كَانَ تَقِيًّۭا
verses.english: This is the paradise We will give as inheritance to those of Our servants who are Godwary.
verses.transliteration_html: Tilka aljannatu allatee noorithu min AAibadina man kana taqiyyan
verses.transliteration_text: Tilka aljannatu allatee noorithu min AAibadina man kana taqiyyan

verses.arabic: وَمَا نَتَنَزَّلُ إِلَّا بِأَمْرِ رَبِّكَ ۖ لَهُۥ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِينَا وَمَا خَلْفَنَا وَمَا بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ ۚ وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِيًّۭا
verses.english: [O Gabriel, tell the Prophet,] ‘We do not descend except by the command of your Lord. To Him belongs whatever is before us and whatever is behind us and whatever is in between that, and your Lord does not forget
verses.transliteration_html: Wama natanazzalu illa biamri rabbika lahu ma bayna aydeena wama khalfana wama bayna thalika wama kana rabbuka nasiyyan
verses.transliteration_text: Wama natanazzalu illa biamri rabbika lahu ma bayna aydeena wama khalfana wama bayna thalika wama kana rabbuka nasiyyan

verses.arabic: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فَٱعْبُدْهُ وَٱصْطَبِرْ لِعِبَـٰدَتِهِۦ ۚ هَلْ تَعْلَمُ لَهُۥ سَمِيًّۭا
verses.english: —the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them. So worship Him and be steadfast in His worship. Do you know anyone who could be His namesake?’
verses.transliteration_html: Rabbu alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma faoAAbudhu waistabir liAAibadatihi hal taAAlamu lahu samiyyan
verses.transliteration_text: Rabbu alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma faoAAbudhu waistabir liAAibadatihi hal taAAlamu lahu samiyyan

verses.arabic: وَيَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَءِذَا مَا مِتُّ لَسَوْفَ أُخْرَجُ حَيًّا
verses.english: Man says, ‘What? Shall I be brought forth alive [from the grave], when I have been dead?’
verses.transliteration_html: Wayaqoolu alinsanu aitha ma mittu lasawfa okhraju hayyan
verses.transliteration_text: Wayaqoolu alinsanu aitha ma mittu lasawfa okhraju hayyan

verses.arabic: أَوَلَا يَذْكُرُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَمْ يَكُ شَيْـًۭٔا
verses.english: Does not man remember that We created him before when he was nothing?
verses.transliteration_html: Awala yathkuru alinsanu anna khalaqnahu min qablu walam yaku shayan
verses.transliteration_text: Awala yathkuru alinsanu anna khalaqnahu min qablu walam yaku shayan

verses.arabic: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَحْشُرَنَّهُمْ وَٱلشَّيَـٰطِينَ ثُمَّ لَنُحْضِرَنَّهُمْ حَوْلَ جَهَنَّمَ جِثِيًّۭا
verses.english: By your Lord, We will surely gather them with the devils; then We will surely bring them up around hell [scrambling] on their knees.
verses.transliteration_html: Fawarabbika lanahshurannahum waalshshayateena thumma lanuhdirannahum hawla jahannama jithiyyan
verses.transliteration_text: Fawarabbika lanahshurannahum waalshshayateena thumma lanuhdirannahum hawla jahannama jithiyyan

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ لَنَنزِعَنَّ مِن كُلِّ شِيعَةٍ أَيُّهُمْ أَشَدُّ عَلَى ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ عِتِيًّۭا
verses.english: Then from every group We shall draw whichever of them was more defiant towards the All-beneficent.
verses.transliteration_html: Thumma lananziAAanna min kulli sheeAAatin ayyuhum ashaddu AAala alrrahmani AAitiyyan
verses.transliteration_text: Thumma lananziAAanna min kulli sheeAAatin ayyuhum ashaddu AAala alrrahmani AAitiyyan

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ لَنَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ أَوْلَىٰ بِهَا صِلِيًّۭا
verses.english: Then surely We will know best those who deserve most to enter it.
verses.transliteration_html: Thumma lanahnu aAAlamu biallatheena hum awla biha siliyyan
verses.transliteration_text: Thumma lanahnu aAAlamu biallatheena hum awla biha siliyyan

verses.arabic: وَإِن مِّنكُمْ إِلَّا وَارِدُهَا ۚ كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ حَتْمًۭا مَّقْضِيًّۭا
verses.english: There is none of you but will come to it: a [matter that is a] decided certainty with your Lord.
verses.transliteration_html: Wain minkum illa wariduha kana AAala rabbika hatman maqdiyyan
verses.transliteration_text: Wain minkum illa wariduha kana AAala rabbika hatman maqdiyyan

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ نُنَجِّى ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوا۟ وَّنَذَرُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ فِيهَا جِثِيًّۭا
verses.english: Then We will deliver those who are Godwary, and leave the wrongdoers in it, fallen on their knees.
verses.transliteration_html: Thumma nunajjee allatheena ittaqaw wanatharu alththalimeena feeha jithiyyan
verses.transliteration_text: Thumma nunajjee allatheena ittaqaw wanatharu alththalimeena feeha jithiyyan

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَـٰتُنَا بَيِّنَـٰتٍۢ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَىُّ ٱلْفَرِيقَيْنِ خَيْرٌۭ مَّقَامًۭا وَأَحْسَنُ نَدِيًّۭا
verses.english: When Our manifest signs are recited to them, the faithless say to the faithful, ‘Which of the two groups is superior in station and better with respect to company?’
verses.transliteration_html: Waitha tutla AAalayhim ayatuna bayyinatin qala allatheena kafaroo lillatheena amanoo ayyu alfareeqayni khayrun maqaman waahsanu nadiyyan
verses.transliteration_text: Waitha tutla AAalayhim ayatuna bayyinatin qala allatheena kafaroo lillatheena amanoo ayyu alfareeqayni khayrun maqaman waahsanu nadiyyan

verses.arabic: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَحْسَنُ أَثَـٰثًۭا وَرِءْيًۭا
verses.english: How many a generation We have destroyed before them, who were superior in furnishings and appearance!
verses.transliteration_html: Wakam ahlakna qablahum min qarnin hum ahsanu athathan wariyan
verses.transliteration_text: Wakam ahlakna qablahum min qarnin hum ahsanu athathan wariyan

verses.arabic: قُلْ مَن كَانَ فِى ٱلضَّلَـٰلَةِ فَلْيَمْدُدْ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ مَدًّا ۚ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ إِمَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ وَإِمَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ شَرٌّۭ مَّكَانًۭا وَأَضْعَفُ جُندًۭا
verses.english: Say, ‘Whoever abides in error, the All-beneficent shall prolong his respite until they sight what they have been promised: either punishment, or the Hour.’ Then they will know whose position is worse, and whose host is weaker.
verses.transliteration_html: Qul man kana fee alddalalati falyamdud lahu alrrahmanu maddan hatta itha raaw ma yooAAadoona imma alAAathaba waimma alssaAAata fasayaAAlamoona man huwa sharrun makanan waadAAafu jundan
verses.transliteration_text: Qul man kana fee alddalalati falyamdud lahu alrrahmanu maddan hatta itha raaw ma yooAAadoona imma alAAathaba waimma alssaAAata fasayaAAlamoona man huwa sharrun makanan waadAAafu jundan

verses.arabic: وَيَزِيدُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱهْتَدَوْا۟ هُدًۭى ۗ وَٱلْبَـٰقِيَـٰتُ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتُ خَيْرٌ عِندَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًۭا وَخَيْرٌۭ مَّرَدًّا
verses.english: Allah enhances in guidance those who are [rightly] guided, and lasting righteous deeds are better with your Lord in reward, and better at the return [to Allah].
verses.transliteration_html: Wayazeedu Allahu allatheena ihtadaw hudan waalbaqiyatu alssalihatu khayrun AAinda rabbika thawaban wakhayrun maraddan
verses.transliteration_text: Wayazeedu Allahu allatheena ihtadaw hudan waalbaqiyatu alssalihatu khayrun AAinda rabbika thawaban wakhayrun maraddan

verses.arabic: أَفَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى كَفَرَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَقَالَ لَأُوتَيَنَّ مَالًۭا وَوَلَدًا
verses.english: Have you not regarded him who defies Our signs, and says, ‘I will surely be given wealth and children’?
verses.transliteration_html: Afaraayta allathee kafara biayatina waqala laootayanna malan wawaladan
verses.transliteration_text: Afaraayta allathee kafara biayatina waqala laootayanna malan wawaladan

verses.arabic: أَطَّلَعَ ٱلْغَيْبَ أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ عَهْدًۭا
verses.english: Has he come to know the Unseen, or taken a promise from the All-beneficent?
verses.transliteration_html: AttalaAAa alghayba ami ittakhatha AAinda alrrahmani AAahdan
verses.transliteration_text: AttalaAAa alghayba ami ittakhatha AAinda alrrahmani AAahdan

verses.arabic: كَلَّا ۚ سَنَكْتُبُ مَا يَقُولُ وَنَمُدُّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ مَدًّۭا
verses.english: No indeed! We will write down what he says, and We will prolong his punishment endlessly.
verses.transliteration_html: Kalla sanaktubu ma yaqoolu wanamuddu lahu mina alAAathabi maddan
verses.transliteration_text: Kalla sanaktubu ma yaqoolu wanamuddu lahu mina alAAathabi maddan

verses.arabic: وَنَرِثُهُۥ مَا يَقُولُ وَيَأْتِينَا فَرْدًۭا
verses.english: We shall take over from him what he talks about, and he will come to Us alone.
verses.transliteration_html: Wanarithuhu ma yaqoolu wayateena fardan
verses.transliteration_text: Wanarithuhu ma yaqoolu wayateena fardan

verses.arabic: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةًۭ لِّيَكُونُوا۟ لَهُمْ عِزًّۭا
verses.english: They have taken gods besides Allah that they may be a [source of] might to them.
verses.transliteration_html: Waittakhathoo min dooni Allahi alihatan liyakoonoo lahum AAizzan
verses.transliteration_text: Waittakhathoo min dooni Allahi alihatan liyakoonoo lahum AAizzan

verses.arabic: كَلَّا ۚ سَيَكْفُرُونَ بِعِبَادَتِهِمْ وَيَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضِدًّا
verses.english: No Indeed! Soon they will disown their worship, and they will be their opponents.
verses.transliteration_html: Kalla sayakfuroona biAAibadatihim wayakoonoona AAalayhim diddan
verses.transliteration_text: Kalla sayakfuroona biAAibadatihim wayakoonoona AAalayhim diddan

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينَ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ تَؤُزُّهُمْ أَزًّۭا
verses.english: Have you not regarded that We unleash the devils upon the faithless to urge them vigorously?
verses.transliteration_html: Alam tara anna arsalna alshshayateena AAala alkafireena taozzuhum azzan
verses.transliteration_text: Alam tara anna arsalna alshshayateena AAala alkafireena taozzuhum azzan

verses.arabic: فَلَا تَعْجَلْ عَلَيْهِمْ ۖ إِنَّمَا نَعُدُّ لَهُمْ عَدًّۭا
verses.english: So do not make haste against them; indeed We are counting for them, a counting [down].
verses.transliteration_html: Fala taAAjal AAalayhim innama naAAuddu lahum AAaddan
verses.transliteration_text: Fala taAAjal AAalayhim innama naAAuddu lahum AAaddan

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ إِلَى ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ وَفْدًۭا
verses.english: The day We shall gather the Godwary toward the All-beneficent, on mounts,
verses.transliteration_html: Yawma nahshuru almuttaqeena ila alrrahmani wafdan
verses.transliteration_text: Yawma nahshuru almuttaqeena ila alrrahmani wafdan

verses.arabic: وَنَسُوقُ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ وِرْدًۭا
verses.english: and drive the guilty as a thirsty herd towards hell,
verses.transliteration_html: Wanasooqu almujrimeena ila jahannama wirdan
verses.transliteration_text: Wanasooqu almujrimeena ila jahannama wirdan

verses.arabic: لَّا يَمْلِكُونَ ٱلشَّفَـٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ عَهْدًۭا
verses.english: no one will have the power to intercede [with Allah], except for him who has taken a covenant with the All-beneficent.
verses.transliteration_html: La yamlikoona alshshafaAAata illa mani ittakhatha AAinda alrrahmani AAahdan
verses.transliteration_text: La yamlikoona alshshafaAAata illa mani ittakhatha AAinda alrrahmani AAahdan

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَلَدًۭا
verses.english: They say, ‘The All-beneficent has taken a son!’
verses.transliteration_html: Waqaloo ittakhatha alrrahmanu waladan
verses.transliteration_text: Waqaloo ittakhatha alrrahmanu waladan

verses.arabic: لَّقَدْ جِئْتُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِدًّۭا
verses.english: You have certainly advanced something hideous!
verses.transliteration_html: Laqad jitum shayan iddan
verses.transliteration_text: Laqad jitum shayan iddan

verses.arabic: تَكَادُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِنْهُ وَتَنشَقُّ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَتَخِرُّ ٱلْجِبَالُ هَدًّا
verses.english: The heavens are about to be rent apart at it, the earth to split open, and the mountains to collapse into bits,
verses.transliteration_html: Takadu alssamawatu yatafattarna minhu watanshaqqu alardu watakhirru aljibalu haddan
verses.transliteration_text: Takadu alssamawatu yatafattarna minhu watanshaqqu alardu watakhirru aljibalu haddan

verses.arabic: أَن دَعَوْا۟ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ وَلَدًۭا
verses.english: that they should ascribe a son to the All-beneficent!
verses.transliteration_html: An daAAaw lilrrahmani waladan
verses.transliteration_text: An daAAaw lilrrahmani waladan

verses.arabic: وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا
verses.english: It does not behoove the All-beneficent to take a son.
verses.transliteration_html: Wama yanbaghee lilrrahmani an yattakhitha waladan
verses.transliteration_text: Wama yanbaghee lilrrahmani an yattakhitha waladan

verses.arabic: إِن كُلُّ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّآ ءَاتِى ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ عَبْدًۭا
verses.english: There is none in the heavens and the earth but he comes to the All-beneficent as a servant.
verses.transliteration_html: In kullu man fee alssamawati waalardi illa atee alrrahmani AAabdan
verses.transliteration_text: In kullu man fee alssamawati waalardi illa atee alrrahmani AAabdan

verses.arabic: لَّقَدْ أَحْصَىٰهُمْ وَعَدَّهُمْ عَدًّۭا
verses.english: Certainly He has counted them [all] and numbered them precisely,
verses.transliteration_html: Laqad ahsahum waAAaddahum AAaddan
verses.transliteration_text: Laqad ahsahum waAAaddahum AAaddan

verses.arabic: وَكُلُّهُمْ ءَاتِيهِ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ فَرْدًا
verses.english: and each of them will come to Him alone on the Day of Resurrection.
verses.transliteration_html: Wakulluhum ateehi yawma alqiyamati fardan
verses.transliteration_text: Wakulluhum ateehi yawma alqiyamati fardan

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ سَيَجْعَلُ لَهُمُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وُدًّۭا
verses.english: Indeed those who have faith and do righteous deeds—the All-beneficent will endear them [to His creation].
verses.transliteration_html: Inna allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati sayajAAalu lahumu alrrahmanu wuddan
verses.transliteration_text: Inna allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati sayajAAalu lahumu alrrahmanu wuddan

verses.arabic: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَـٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لِتُبَشِّرَ بِهِ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ وَتُنذِرَ بِهِۦ قَوْمًۭا لُّدًّۭا
verses.english: Indeed We have made it simple in your language so that you may give good news thereby to the Godwary and warn with it a disputatious lot.
verses.transliteration_html: Fainnama yassarnahu bilisanika litubashshira bihi almuttaqeena watunthira bihi qawman luddan
verses.transliteration_text: Fainnama yassarnahu bilisanika litubashshira bihi almuttaqeena watunthira bihi qawman luddan

verses.arabic: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هَلْ تُحِسُّ مِنْهُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ أَوْ تَسْمَعُ لَهُمْ رِكْزًۢا
verses.english: How many a generation We have destroyed before them! Can you descry any one of them, or hear from them so much as a murmur?
verses.transliteration_html: Wakam ahlakna qablahum min qarnin hal tuhissu minhum min ahadin aw tasmaAAu lahum rikzan
verses.transliteration_text: Wakam ahlakna qablahum min qarnin hal tuhissu minhum min ahadin aw tasmaAAu lahum rikzan
